title: Chef John's Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Moist, chewy peanut butter cookies full of sweet and salty flavor.

steps: In a stand mixer, beat the butter, white sugar, brown sugar, peanut butter, salt, baking powder and baking soda until smooth. Scrape down the bowl and beater.
Add the egg and mix for about 1 minute.
With the mixer on low, slowly add the flour. Scrape down the bowl and beater, then keep mixing until the dough comes together, about 30 seconds.
Shape the dough into a ball, wrap it in plastic, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat.
Portion the dough into equal-sized balls on the baking sheet. Roll them smooth with damp hands, then press each with a fork in a criss-cross pattern.
Bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Let the cookies sit on the sheet briefly, then move them to a wire rack to cool completely.
